turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
st run:



Place the silicone dish on top of the warmer, then add 2–3 wax bears in one scent.


Plug the warmer into a standard outlet. Press the Power Timer button twice for 3 hours—a nice short first session. Three presses sets 6 hours; four sets 9 hours.


When you’re done, let the wax cool completely before lifting off the dish. Once it’s solid, you can pop it out when you’re ready to change scents.



The warmer and melted wax get hot, so leave the dish in place until everything has cooled.
